acceptanceCriteria: No wire.Errorf(wire.CodeOf(err), ...) re-wrap remains that drops NotRetryable; a test or static check fails on reintroduction.
A regression test drives one former site with a NotRetryable error and asserts the mark survives.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 tasks-cli bug lane (branch claude/bugs-tasks-cli, V1-0908 fix 4a1d9bf63 covers the five annotator helpers only). Many call sites rebuild an error with wire.Errorf(wire.CodeOf(err), ...), e.g. internal/tasks/cli/mutate_batch.go:155,164, archive/export.go, run_batch.go and store/*, losing NotRetryable so callers may retry a non-retryable failure. Expected: a re-wrap helper that preserves the whole error, used at every such site, plus a vet-style test that forbids the bare pattern.
title: wire.Errorf(wire.CodeOf(err), ...) re-wraps drop the NotRetryable mark (V1-0908 residual)
